t: This is Bracken House, on Cannon Street, just southeast of St Paul's Cathedral. It was built on a cleared bomb site and designed by Sir Albert Richardson, in a late style of modern classicism. It was the Financial Times headquarters until the 1980s, and became so again from May 2019. The name honours Brendan Bracken, the Irish-born politician who served in Churchill's War Cabinet as Minister of Information and First Lord of the Admiralty. The architect Michael Hopkins is also linked to the building through its design.
